description: This PHP source file defines the EmailSubscriberAPI class, which handles CRUD operations and API endpoints for managing email subscribers within the OrangeHRM system's admin module. It includes methods for listing, creating, retrieving, updating, and deleting email subscribers associated with specific email notification subscriptions, along with validation rules and Swagger/OpenAPI documentation annotations.

classes.name: EmailSubscriberAPI
classes.description: This class provides REST API endpoints for managing email subscribers associated with email notification subscriptions, including listing, creation, retrieval, updating, and deletion functionalities within the OrangeHRM admin module.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Handles HTTP GET request to list all email subscribers for a specific email subscription, supporting sorting and pagination.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Handles HTTP POST request to create a new email subscriber under a specific email subscription.

methods.name: setParamsToEmailSubscriber
methods.description: Populates an EmailSubscriber entity with parameters from the request object.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Returns validation rules for the getAll method, including subscription ID and sorting parameters.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Handles HTTP DELETE request to remove one or more email subscribers by their IDs.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Returns validation rules for the delete method, validating subscription ID and list of IDs to delete.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Handles HTTP GET request to retrieve a specific email subscriber by ID.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Returns validation rules for retrieving a single email subscriber.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Handles HTTP PUT request to update an existing email subscriber.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Returns validation rules for updating an email subscriber, including uniqueness validation for email.

methods.name: getCommonBodyValidationRules
methods.description: Provides validation rules for the request body when creating or updating subscribers, including email, name, and subscription ID validation.

methods.name: getEmailSubscriberCommonUniqueOption
methods.description: Creates and returns an EntityUniquePropertyOption object to handle email uniqueness validation, ignoring the current record during updates.
